'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Mason DS Agents In The Court''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Mason]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Inventory Ryan Muench; sheet Ryan Mason. Agents/Shada Court package.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Mason]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
